jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

 

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain.

Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. 

A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.

You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. 

 

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four
  • Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard
  • Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities
  • Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity
  • Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature
  • Lead the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service

 

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • You have owned a coverage, completeness or data quality metric as your primary objective, and can say what it went from, to what, and over how long
  • You have worked at millions-of-records scale
  • You have moved that metric through teams that did not report to you, setting interfaces, contracts and SLAs with partner teams
  • You have shipped under a hard regulatory or consent constraint, in health, finance or identity, with privacy and consent by design
  • You have real technical depth: you have owned a data platform component as a product, a feature store, a context or profile service, or an identity layer. 
  • You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • You have had a data quality problem surface only once it reached a downstream consumer, and you changed how you worked because of it
  • You have built a completeness or quality definition and made an organisation adopt it
  • You have worked on interoperability, health data standards, or identity and account models

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children
  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT
  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib
  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class
  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription
  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib
  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

jobs.title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Your mission As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem , you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.
 ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.
 Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.
 You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.
 Your day-to-day  
 Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
 Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
 Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
 Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
 Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner , balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
 Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
 Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
 Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
 Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
 Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.
 

 Your profile At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.
 You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
 You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
 You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
 You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
 You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
 You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.

jobs.title: Product Manager - EXOtube
jobs.description:
Introduction Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. 
 
Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. With a decade of flight heritage and over 830 satellites launched across  48 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. The company fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, the world's most innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.

 Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products, Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution, we're making benefits more accessible, valued and global.

You'll start in Insurances, which powers how employers offer and manage group cover: health, dental, vision, critical illness, life and income protection. It's our most complex area, and the work is turning underwriting and compliance rules into flows an employee can finish in minutes.
 
That won't be the whole of it. Our teams are loosely split between Insurances and Core/Finance, and people work across the problem set.  Ship fast at a high quality bar, and hold the team to it

 An entrepreneurial streak. You've founded something, worked at an early-stage startup, or spent time in engineering before moving into product

jobs.title: Product Manager - Discover
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar 

 BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely. 
 

 Your Mission 

 As the Product Manager for the Discover squad, you will focus on the upper funnel of the passenger journey. Your mission is to capture global traffic via SEO and emerging LLM-based search (GEO), ensuring passengers have a seamless experience when they land on our platform. You will build a vision that maximizes conversion from all acquisition channels, prioritizing high-impact projects across our core markets.

 
 The Team 

 
 
 The Demand Team: The Discover squad is a core team of the Demand pillar, owning the end-to-end passenger experience alongside Search, Booking, Payment, and Post-booking.

 
 Your Squad: You will co-lead the Discover squad alongside an Engineering Manager. The squad consists of 6 front-end engineers.

 
 Internal Stakeholders: Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing Managers, Product Data, Product Design, and Business leads.

 

 Your Responsibilities 

 Shape the Discover strategy & roadmap: Define the Product and Engineering vision for the Discover scope, along with the appropriate KPIs to measure progress. You will take full responsibility for your scope from strategy to execution. 

 Drive top-funnel acquisition: Partner with the Marketing and SEO teams to define and deliver the acquisition roadmap. This includes adapting our architecture for the AI era to ensure our inventory is easily crawlable by LLMs and AI agents. 

 Maximize landing page conversion: Define and deliver a strategy to optimize the landing experience and maximize conversion from all channels. You will leverage AB tests to run experiments and drive our Land-to-Book conversion targets. 

 Navigate cross-functional alignment: Act as the go-to product person for all Discover topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions, and ensure alignment across Engineering, Marketing, Design, Data, and Business teams. 

 Manage the Busfor platform: Act as the referent Product Manager for Busfor, a standalone brand acquired and owned by BlaBlaCar operating in Eastern Europe 

 Your Qualifications 

 Experience: 3+ years of Product Management. An experience in top-of-funnel acquisition, growth, or SEO is preferred but not required. 

 Problem-Solving: Highly analytical with a proven track record of using A/B testing to deliver fast, incremental impact on conversion rates. 

 Stakeholder Influence: Strong interpersonal skills to navigate cross-functional relationships, gain buy-in, and clearly communicate prioritization decisions. 

 Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory. 

 If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application! 

 What we have to offer 

 2 to 3 days at the office per week

 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

 Financial support for home office equipment

 Minimum 25 days holiday per year

 Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

 Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

 Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like. 

 A 45-min video-call with Talent Acquisition.

 A 45-minute video call with the Lead Product Manager.

 Remote use case exercise, followed by a 45-minute presentation to a cross-functional panel of key stakeholders.

 30-minute video call with the CPO for final validation

 Our hiring process lasts on average 20-25 days and offers usually come within 48 hours.
 BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités , nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles. 
 Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Product Manager confirmé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Produit et prendre la responsabilité d’un domaine fonctionnel clé de notre plateforme. Le terrain de jeu est vaste et les défis nombreux : internationalisation, intelligence artificielle, agents, automatisation des workflows, interconnectivité, refonte fonctionnelle et amélioration continue de l’expérience utilisateur. 
 
 Tes principales missions : 
 Rattaché(e) à la VP Product, tu seras responsable d’un domaine fonctionnel de notre plateforme et de son évolution à long terme.

 Définir et porter la vision de ton domaine produit.

 Favoriser l’alignement autour des priorités produit.

 Contribuer à la diffusion de la culture Produit au sein de l’entreprise.

 Tu sais appréhender des problématiques métier complexes et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces.

 Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et tu cherches à comprendre les sujets en profondeur avant de prendre des décisions.

jobs.title: Project Manager & Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation 
 BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.
 Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.
 We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today. 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (if you are not located in the Zurich area), the role will be based remotely from Germany or Austria or onsite in Zurich.
As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month — these visits are financially supported by BLP.

 Your Mission 
 As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you’ll operate at the intersection of business and tech — leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You’ll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.
 If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the implementation journey end-to-end — from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

 Translate complexity into clarity — design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

 Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers’ unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

 Be the client’s trusted partner — anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp’s automation.

 Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

 Feed the product loop — translate feedback into long-term improvements to continuously evolve our platform.

 
 What We’re Really Looking For 
 The following key attributes ensure success in this role:
 Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

 Managing Ambiguity – You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

 Growth Mindset – You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

 Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

 Customer-First Mentality – You think beyond implementation — you care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

 
 What You Bring 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

 Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

 Strong analytical and communication skills — you can translate business needs into technical action.

 Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

 Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus

 Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

 
 Benefits 
 High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

 Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

 Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

 Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

 Employee ownership – be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

 Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

 Technology exposure – be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

 About Us 
 Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world.  What You’ll Do 
 Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base.

 Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent.

 Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

 Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results.

 Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

 Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost.

jobs.description:
About our team: 
 Radiant is at the forefront of AI infrastructure, revolutionising the connection between software and hardware for the AI era. Our mission is to empower AI teams with scalable, secure, and efficient infrastructure solutions that support seamless model training, deployment, and scaling.
 Join a team operating some of the world’s most advanced high-performance computing infrastructure. As a Cloud Support Engineer, you will support cutting-edge GPU and CPU platforms — including the latest NVIDIA architectures — powering dense, large-scale compute environments used for AI, machine learning, and next-generation workloads.
 This is an opportunity to build expertise at the forefront of modern infrastructure, where reliability, scale, and performance matter every day. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers across a globally distributed organisation that values openness, inclusion, technical excellence, and continuous learning.
 We move quickly, solve meaningful challenges, and give people the space to make an impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy working with advanced technology, and want to help shape the future of high-performance compute, you’ll find both challenge and opportunity here.
 Job Summary: 
 As a Senior/Principal Product Manager – Storage & Networking, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the storage and networking capabilities underpinning Radiant’s GPU platform.
 You’ll work across bare-metal GPU clusters, Kubernetes, high-performance storage, data-centre networking, infrastructure inventory, automation, and observability, partnering closely with engineering, SRE, infrastructure, networking, and operations.
 This is a highly technical product role focused on ensuring GPU workloads have reliable, high-throughput, low-latency infrastructure at scale.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for storage and networking capabilities across the GPU platform.

 Define and prioritise storage capabilities based on customer, workload, performance, scale, and operational needs.

 Define and prioritise networking capabilities across the platform, from data centre infrastructure through to customer and workload connectivity.

 Partner with engineering to turn requirements into scalable, reliable platform services.

 Drive improvements in automation, self-service, observability, and operational efficiency.

 Define success metrics and use them to guide performance, reliability, capacity, and investment decisions.

 Qualifications: 
 Experience owning technical infrastructure, platform, storage, networking, or cloud products end-to-end.

 Experience working in data centre, bare-metal, cloud, HPC, AI infrastructure, or similar environments.

 Good understanding of modern storage technologies and architectures, and familiarity with file, object and block storage, WEKA, VAST, DDN, or similar.

 Good understanding of modern data centre and high-performance networking technologies, with familiarity with technologies such as Ethernet, InfiniBand, RDMA, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, and modern switching platforms.

 Familiarity with how storage and networking integrate with Kubernetes, bare-metal infrastructure, and large-scale compute platforms.

 Comfortable working closely with specialist engineers and making informed product and technical trade-offs.

 Strong prioritisation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

 Comfortable taking ambiguous infrastructure problems from discovery through to delivery.

 What you bring: 
 Systems thinking: Understand how compute, storage, networking, and platform services fit together.

 Product thinking: Turn infrastructure capabilities into clear, scalable services for customers and internal teams.

 Technical fluency: Work credibly with engineering without needing to be the domain expert.

 Prioritisation: Balance customer needs, performance, reliability, cost, and complexity.

 Ownership: Drive problems from discovery through delivery and adoption.

 Our values: 
 Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

 Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

 You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

 What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.
 Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:
 25 days of annual leave

 We’re on a mission to help power the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy. You will be a key part within our NuOrder by Lightspeed group to help Lightspeed make great products and strong decisions grounded in data. 

If you’re looking to work in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment that impacts a large global customer base - let’s talk! The ideal candidate will have a strong background in product management, product strategy, UX, data analytics and a passion for delivering exceptional user experiences in the retail industry.

jobs.description:
📍London or UK Remote | 💰£110,000 - £125,000 + Stock Options + Benefits | Hear from the team ✨

 

⭐Our Design team

We’re a team of 100+ designers, researchers, and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design makes up almost half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, and engineering to solve real customer problems at scale.

 

We design for the "magic moments"

We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product is our personality. We blend research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.

Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.

The Operations Collective is where we design how help and customer support works at Monzo. We think holistically about the experience of getting support as a customer, and how that connects to the systems, tools, and people behind the scenes.

We’re focused on delivering effortless, tech-led support experiences that can scale as Monzo grows. That means understanding customer problems deeply, preventing support needs where possible, solving issues at their source within the product, and designing seamless journeys whether customers self-serve or speak to a customer support agent. 

AI and automation play a central role, empowering customers to resolve simpler issues independently, and equipping our operations teams with intelligent tools to handle more complex cases with confidence and speed. We design across the full ecosystem: customer journeys, internal platforms, routing, and the foundations that enable us to scale safely.

There’s a real opportunity to shape how help works across Monzo, end to end. 

 

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

  • Embedding the long-term design vision for support experiences at Monzo, shaping how customer-facing journeys, internal systems, and human service connect into one coherent ecosystem.
  • Leading large, end-to-end design initiatives across ambiguous problem spaces, spanning AI-enabled help experiences, internal tooling, and operational workflows.
  • Designing with a service mindset, understanding what happens beyond the interface and shaping the real-world impact of your design decisions.
  • Designing across touchpoints; from the app, to the phone, to human support.
  • Navigating tradeoffs and guiding strategic decisions in an opinionated way.
  • Coaching the other Ops Collective designers by helping them to embed the vision in their work, running design crits and supporting them to shape their work. 
  • Continuing to raise the bar for design craft and product excellence at Monzo, ensuring your work is a benchmark for quality and innovation across the organisation and our industry.
  • Partnering with cross-functional leaders to define and execute product strategies that translate into actionable plans you help build and ship.
  • Proactively addressing systemic challenges, reducing complexity, and creating better conditions for teams to deliver impactful work.
  • Acting as a visible ambassador for Design, sharing your work and its impact across the company to maintain Design’s place at the heart of Monzo.
  • Mentoring and levelling up designers across the discipline, fostering a culture of growth, collaboration, and belonging.

 

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re an expert in your craft, with deep expertise in a specific design discipline and strong foundational skills across all areas of product design.
  • You’re comfortable designing for AI and automation-enabled environments, and excited by the opportunities AI creates to rethink how services operate.
  • You have experience working on complex service ecosystems, where digital products connect to real-world operations, people, or logistics.
  • You’re passionate about improving how humans and technology work together, creating experiences that feel seamless to customers and empowering to the teams delivering support.
  • You have a proven track record of delivering high-impact design work that drives customer outcomes, influences company metrics, and achieves commercial goals.
  • You’ll have excellent visual, UI and interaction skills, and the ability to think through complex interaction design. 
  • You thrive in ambiguity, leading teams to deliver in complex, fast-changing environments while maintaining a high bar for quality.
  • You’re a strategic thinke

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
  • Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
  • Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.
  • Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.
  • Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.
  • Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.

Stellenbeschreibung Du weißt, dass ein gutes Produkt nicht in PowerPoint entsteht. 
 Sondern in Fabriken, Samples, Materialentscheidungen, Verhandlungen und tausend Details, die am Ende darüber entscheiden, ob ein Schuh wirklich funktioniert. 
 Du kennst China nicht nur aus Calls. 
 Du warst vor Ort. 
 Du hast mit Fabriken verhandelt, Samples korrigiert, Qualitätsprobleme gelöst und Produktionsverzögerungen selbst erlebt. 
 Und wenn etwas kritisch wird, wartest du nicht darauf, dass sich das Problem von allein löst. 
 Du gehst rein. 
 Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über  1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Heute arbeiten über  150 Mitarbeitende daran, aus Pammys eine internationale Footwear Brand zu machen. 
 Mit unserem Wachstum steigt auch die Komplexität unserer Produktentwicklung. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen  Head of Product Development (m/w/d) , der unsere Produktentwicklung fachlich und operativ auf das nächste Level bringt. 
 Du verantwortest den gesamten Entwicklungsprozess vom ersten Konzept bis zum produktionsreifen Schuh und arbeitest eng mit Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, Quality und unserem Director Product zusammen. 

 Deine Aufgaben Gesamtverantwortung für die Produktentwicklung unserer Footwear-Kollektionen vom ersten Konzept bis zur Produktionsfreigabe
 Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung und Weiterentwicklung des Product Development Teams 
 Direkte Steuerung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fabriken, Produzenten und Lieferanten in China

 Steuerung aller relevanten Timelines und Sicherstellung, dass Entwicklungen pünktlich, in der richtigen Qualität und zu wirtschaftlich starken Konditionen abgeschlossen werden
 Konsequentes Troubleshooting bei Qualitäts-, Material-, Produktions- oder Lieferproblemen
 Regelmäßige und auch kurzfristige Reisen nach China und zu weiteren Produktionsstandorten , wenn Themen vor Ort gelöst werden müssen
 Enge Abstimmung mit Footwear Design, Merchandising, Quality, Sourcing und Director Product
 Entwicklung und Optimierung von Produkten, Materialien, Passformen, Konstruktionen und Produktionsprozessen 
 Steuerung von Lieferanten hinsichtlich Qualität, Geschwindigkeit, Kosten und technischer Umsetzung 
 Aufbau klarer Entwicklungsprozesse, Standards und Verantwortlichkeiten
 Identifikation von Risiken im Entwicklungsprozess und frühzeitiges Gegensteuern
 Kontinuierliche Beobachtung von Material-, Produktions- und Footwear-Trends 
 

 Dein Profil Langjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Footwear Product Development , idealerweise in einer schnell wachsenden Footwear-, Fashion- oder Consumer Brand
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Product Development Teams 
 Sehr tiefgehende China-Erfahrung und nachweisbare Zusammenarbeit mit chinesischen Fabriken und Lieferanten
 Belastbares Netzwerk zu Produzenten, Fabriken und relevanten Partnern in China
 Sehr gutes Verständnis von Footwear Construction, Materialien, Passform, Leisten, Sohlen, Komponenten und Produktionsprozessen 
 Nachweisbare Erfahrung in Sampling, Fittings, Quality Control, Costing und Produktionsfreigaben 
 Hohe technische Kompetenz und die Fähigkeit, Qualitäts- und Produktionsprobleme direkt mit Fabriken zu lösen
 Starkes Verhandlungsgeschick und Erfahrung in der Steuerung internationaler Lieferanten
 Sehr hohe Reisebereitschaft , insbesondere nach China
 Bereitschaft, auch kurzfristig vor Ort zu sein, wenn kritische Produkt- oder Produktionsprobleme gelöst werden müssen
 Hohe Belastbarkeit, Entscheidungsstärke und ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität
 Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert und übernimmst Verantwortung bis zum finalen Ergebnis
 Du bist schnell in der Auffassung, pragmatisch in der Umsetzung und gleichzeitig extrem genau, wenn es um Produktqualität geht
 Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere relevante Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus
 

 Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Ownership: Du verantwortest einen der wichtigsten Bereiche unserer Produktorganisation
 Internationaler Scope: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Fabriken und Partnern in China
 Impact: Deine Entscheidungen beeinflussen Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Erfolg unserer Produkte unmittelbar
 Leadership: Führe und entwickle ein wachsendes Product Development Team
 Speed: Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Director Product und der Geschäftsführung

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

 This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

 When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

 We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.

 Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

 If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

 What You’ll Own:

 
 Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.

 Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.

 Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.

 Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.

 Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.

 Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.

 Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.

 
 What Success Looks Like:

 
 You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.

 Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.

 Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.

 Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.

 You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.

 You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.

 
 What You Bring

 
 Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.

 Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.

 Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.

 Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.

 Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.

jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products
 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship 
 One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 
 50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next 
 
 At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.
 Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first .
 And we’re only just getting started! 
 
 Our Team
 We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.
 
 Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]
 • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership 
 • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) 
 • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 
 
 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]
 • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) 
 
 Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]
 • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) 
 
 Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]
 • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A 
 • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) 
 • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) 
 • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) 
 
 Your Role
 Most Product Manager roles are built around specs and handoffs, waiting on a designer's mockup, an engineer's sprint slot, a data analyst's report.
 This role is built differently: we're hiring a PM who does more than decide what should be built. You'll steer a developer squad end to end: investigating opportunities, analyzing user behaviour, prototyping solutions with AI, contributing code, launching experiments, and improving what reaches production.
 You'll work directly with Pierre Gerbaud, Product Lead, and Michael Monin, our Co-founder & CTO, on a product already used by more than 50 million people and growing toward 100 million users.
 At this scale, every small improvement can create significant impact, and you'll have the space to spot these opportunities and act on them quickly.
 If your first instinct is to test an idea by making it real, this is your role. 
 
 Your Responsibilities
 Own the work end to end, not just a piece of it: Understand the problem, choose an approach, build the solution (AI-assisted coding, opening pull requests, working with internal tools), launch it, measure it, and iterate with as few handoffs as possible;

 Decide what's worth pursuing, and test it fast: When a dozen directions look plausible and there are more ideas than time, identify the opportunities that matter most and design the smallest meaningful experiment to test your assumptions;

 Let the results determine what happens next: Define success before you build, analyse the outcome once the experiment is live, and use what you learn to improve, expand, or stop what you shipped;

 Work embedded in a software engineering squad: partner directly with Leads, Co-founders, designers, and engineers to define and deliver priority projects, and communicate progress and decisions to all relevant stakeholders;

 Keep momentum high: Surface blockers the moment they appear, challenge assumptions directly regardless of who made them, and find another route forward when the obvious one is blocked;

 
 Your Qualifications
 You build with AI: you’ve personally built and shipped a functional feature, experiment, prototype, workflow, or tool using AI coding tools. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar tools are already part of how you work everyday;

 You use data to make product decisions: you can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next;

 You explore AI independently: you actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

 You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. jobs.title: Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Hi, wir sind Doonails! 💅🏼 Ein schnell wachsendes Beauty-Startup, das die Manikürewelt revolutioniert. Mit innovativen Produkten, einer starken Community und Präsenz im Online-Shop sowie bei führenden Retail-Partnern bringen wir Studio-Qualität direkt zu unseren Kund:innen nach Hause, einfach, schnell und stilvoll.

 Und genau hier kommst DU ins Spiel.

 Damit unser Sortiment auch in Zukunft begeistert und Trends setzt, suchen wir dich!

 Als Product Manager (m/w/d) bist du der kreative und strategische Kopf hinter unserem Produktportfolio. Du erkennst Beauty-Trends, bevor sie entstehen und steuerst neue Produktentwicklungen sowie Produktoptimierungen zielgerichtet von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Launch. Wenn du datengetriebenes Denken, echte Produktleidenschaft und Umsetzungsstärke verbindest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

 Deine Rolle & dein Impact ⚡️ 
 
 Du gibst unseren Produkten ihre Daseinsberechtigung und machst Innovationen für unsere Community greifbar. Als Schnittstelle zwischen Trendgespür, Performance-Zahlen und operativer Umsetzung verwandelst du Marktchancen in erfolgreiche Launches. Du stellst sicher, dass Doonails nicht nur bestehende Kund:innen begeistert, sondern mit innovativen Formulierungen und Produkten den Beauty-Markt nachhaltig prägt.

 

 Deine zentralen Aufgaben 👩‍💻👨‍💻 
 
 End-to-End Produktentwicklung (NPD) 

 
 
 Du übernimmst die operative End-to-End-Verantwortung für neue Produktentwicklungen von der ersten Idee über die Konzeptionierung bis hin zum erfolgreichen Marktlaunch.

 Portfolio-Optimierung & Bestandspflege 

 
 
 Du evaluierst fortlaufend Optimierungspotenziale unserer Bestandsprodukte, treibst Qualitätsverbesserungen voran und steuerst die Weiterentwicklung unseres Sortiments.

 Trend- & Marktanalysen 

 
 
 Du analysierst Markt-, Trend- und Wettbewerbsdaten sowie gezieltes Kundenfeedback, identifizierst neue Produkttrends und leitest daraus zukunftsfähige Produktinnovationen ab.

 Performance & Business-Impact 

 
 
 Du behältst relevante Produkt-KPIs (Absatz, Umsatz, Margen) fest im Blick und leitest daraus datenbasierte Handlungsempfehlungen für das bestehende und zukünftige Portfolio ab.

 Schnittstellen- & Lieferantensteuerung 

 
 
 Du steuerst die enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams (Einkauf/Ops, Brand/Marketing, Sales/Vertrieb) sowie externen Partnern wie Produzenten, Lieferanten und Dufthäusern.

 

 Das bringst du mit 🤝 

 
 Erfahrung: Fundierte Berufserfahrung im Product Management / New Product Development (NPD), idealerweise bei einer D2C-Brand, im FMCG- oder Beauty-Umfeld.

 Skincare-Erfahrung: Praktische Erfahrung oder fundiertes Know-how im Bereich Skincare/Hautpflege sind ein großes Plus.

 
 Trend-Gespür & Customer Focus: Leidenschaft für Beauty-Trends, ein feines Gespür für Konsumentenbedürfnisse und den Anspruch, bestehende Produkte noch besser zu machen.

 
 Analytische Stärke: Souveräner Umgang mit Markt- und Sales-Zahlen (KPIs, Umsatz- & Absatzdaten) sowie die Fähigkeit, daraus konkrete Strategien abzuleiten.

 
 Schnittstellen- & Partner-Know-how: Erfahrung in der Koordination externer Partner (Lieferanten, Dufthäuser, Hersteller) und internen Stakeholdern.

 
 Prozess- & Projektstärke: Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit starkem Hands-on-Mentalität.

 
 Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

 Deine Perspektive 📈 
 Du wächst mit der stetigen Skalierung unseres Produktportfolios und der Erschließung neuer Beauty-Kategorien mit. Je tiefer du in Trendanalysen, Lieferanten-Netzwerke und datengetriebenes Portfolio-Management eintauchst, desto mehr Verantwortung übernimmst du bei strategischen Launches, internationalen Sortimentsanpassungen und zukunftsweisenden Produktinnovationen.

 Was wir dir bieten 💝 

 
 💸 Faire Bezahlung, angepasst an deine Qualifikation & Erfahrung

 Du hast bereits mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Produktentwicklung oder agiler Projektarbeit.

 Du hast bereits Erfahrung als Product Owner oder als Teil eines eingespielten Softwareentwicklungsteams gesammelt.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission This is a company built for growth. 
 When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.  
 We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling. 
 As  Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x) , this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting. 
 If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you. 
 What You'll Own: 
 Technical product strategy & vision  Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities. 

 Discovery, scoping & prioritization  You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately. 

 Agile ownership & delivery  You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work. 

 Technical stakeholder alignment  You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle. 

 Experimentation & continuous improvement  You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and  technical  improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up. 

 

 What You Bring Technical Product Manager experience  Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations. 

 Engineering fluency  You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer. 

 Agile ownership  You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus. 

 Data-driven product decisions  Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself. 

 High-scale product teams  At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users. 

 Discovery & problem solving  Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions. 

 Ownership mindset  You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Das sind wir

 An mehreren Standorten in Europa arbeiten unsere Teams täglich daran, Versandprozesse nachhaltig zu vereinfachen. Wir setzen auf offene Zusammenarbeit sowie kurze Entscheidungswege und suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Ideen einbringen und aktiv mitgestalten möchten.

 Deine Rolle

 Als (Technical) Product Owner (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres Product Teams und übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale technische Schnittstellen und Integrationen unserer Plattformen. Dein Fokus liegt insbesondere auf unseren Customer APIs, der Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) sowie perspektivisch der Unified Financial Platform (UFP) und unserer HubSpot-Integration.

 Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product, Engineering und Business. Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge, übersetzt unterschiedliche Anforderungen in klare Prioritäten und sorgst gemeinsam mit unseren Teams dafür, dass unsere Integrationen zuverlässig funktionieren und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

 Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Product Ownern, unserem Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers und Data Insights zusammen und bist gleichzeitig wichtige Ansprechperson für interne Stakeholder, Kunden, Carrier und externe Partner.

 Deine Aufgaben

 
 Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Roadmap unserer Customer APIs für LMS Enterprise und LMS Next und entwickelst diese strategisch weiter.

 Du treibst die Migration unserer API-Kunden von LMS Enterprise zu LMS Next voran und identifizierst, welche Features und Carrier-Integrationen dafür benötigt werden.

 Du bist technische Ansprechperson für unsere API-Kunden und unterstützt bei Fragen sowie bei der Analyse und Lösung von Problemen.

 Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unified Carrier Interface (UCI).

 Du analysierst Anforderungen an Carrier-Features und Services, bereitest diese für unser Engineering auf und unterstützt QA bei der Definition relevanter Test Cases.

 Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Carriern und klärst technische Anforderungen und Besonderheiten rund um deren Integrationen.

 Nach dem Go-live übernimmst du die Verantwortung für unsere Unified Financial Platform (UFP) und steuerst deren Backlog und Weiterentwicklung.

 Du behältst unsere bestehende HubSpot-Integration im Blick und priorisierst Anpassungen entsprechend neuer Business-Anforderungen und Feedbacks.

 Über alle Themen hinweg bringst du Engineering, Business Stakeholder, Carrier und externe Partner zusammen und sorgst für klare Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen.

 
 Das bringst du mit

 
 Du verfügst über einen technischen Hintergrund, beispielsweise in Software Engineering oder Informatik, oder hast bereits mehrere Jahre an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product und Engineering gearbeitet.

 Du bringst Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager mit – idealerweise im Umfeld von APIs, Plattformen oder technischen Integrationen.

 Du hast ein gutes Verständnis von APIs, API Design, Versionierung und Migrationsstrategien und kannst technische Diskussionen mit unseren Engineers auf Augenhöhe führen.

 Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verstehen und sie für unterschiedliche Stakeholder verständlich übersetzen.

 Du bist sicher im Stakeholder Management und kannst unterschiedliche technische und wirtschaftliche Anforderungen gegeneinander abwägen und priorisieren.

 Mehrere parallele Workstreams und wechselnde Prioritäten bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept – du behältst den Überblick und setzt klare Schwerpunkte.

 Du arbeitest gerne kollaborativ und standortübergreifend mit Kollegen in Hamburg und Naarden zusammen.

 Du interessierst dich für AI Tools und digitale Lösungen und probierst gerne neue Wege aus, um Prozesse und Workflows effizienter zu gestalten.

 Erfahrung in Logistik, Parcel oder Freight Tech, insbesondere mit Carrier-API-Integrationen, ist ein Plus.

 Kenntnisse rund um HubSpot bzw. CRM-Integrationen oder Finanz- und Invoicing Systeme sind ebenfalls von Vorteil.

 
 Warum ITA Logistics Group?

 Bei uns erwartet dich ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind und Feedback nicht nur erlaubt, sondern erwünscht ist. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, arbeiten agil und entwickeln uns kontinuierlich weiter. Dazu gehört für uns auch der Einsatz moderner digitaler Tools und KI-Anwendungen, die deinen Arbeitsalltag sinnvoll unterstützen und Prozesse effizienter machen.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Project Manager (Relocation to Luxembourg)
jobs.description:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Luxembourg office. 
 
 About us 
 Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . 
 That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.
 
 What you'll be doing 
 As our Senior Strategic Project Manager within the Office of the CEO, you will be a primary execution driver behind our most critical cross-functional initiatives. You will serve as the strategic bridge connecting executive leadership with operational, regulatory, product, and business teams across our Luxembourg and Milan hubs.
 While you will work side-by-side with internal Legal, Compliance, and Risk experts who own the regulatory subject matter, your core strength is senior strategic leadership and project execution: acting as a key leader within the organization to orchestrate complex initiatives across different verticals, driving high-impact project timelines, and turning corporate obligations into seamless operational workflows.
 Here's what that looks like in practice:
 Solve complex business challenges - Tackling intricate business problems by developing innovative, data-backed solutions with a consistent user-first approach.

 Stakeholder management and strategic partnership - Managing relationships with C-level stakeholders and acting as a thought partner for leadership on specific strategic areas.

 Strategic influence - Influencing major decisions through in-depth analysis and proven insights, integrating diverse perspectives into coherent strategies.

 Champion methodology and best practices - Developing and introducing new methodologies, best practices, or frameworks within the team or company, ensuring a consistent user-first approach.

 Champion Regulatory Requirements in Roadmap Design - Act as the project manager champion for what regulatory and supervisory requirements apply to a given initiative, ensuring they are proactively factored into project roadmaps at the design stage - partnering closely with Legal, Compliance, and Risk.

 Govern & Monitor Multi-Hub Projects - Establish project governance, track milestones across offices, proactively remove cross-departmental bottlenecks, mitigate delivery risks, and provide crisp, data-driven reporting to executive leadership.

 Anchor Luxembourg Operational Synergies - Serve as an authoritative on-the-ground project leader in Luxembourg, ensuring that financial institution governance requirements seamlessly harmonize with Satispay’s group-wide strategy and product velocity.

 
 Who we're looking for 
 This role needs someone who is a problem-solver that loves teamwork, gets things done, and is ready for real ownership across regulated financial environments.
 Experience - Minimum 6–7 years of hands-on experience within a regulated environment -ideally within high-growth Fintech, Scale-ups, EMI/Banking institutions, or Financial Services.

 Regulatory Expertise - Hands-on knowledge and deep familiarity with compliance, legal, and regulatory matters.

 Master Project Operator - Proven track record of managing complex, end-to-end multi-stakeholder initiatives using structured project management frameworks.

 Fintech & EMI Licensing Awareness - Good high-level familiarity with the fintech landscape, EMI/payment institution dynamics, and European financial regulation concepts (PSD2/PSD3, AML/CFT, GDPR) — enough to translate requirements into project delivery without needing to be the legal specialist yourself.

 Cross-Border Leadership - Demonstrated ability to build consensus, establish momentum, and align priorities across distributed international offices and matrixed teams.

jobs.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.
 We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.
 Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.
 
 The Opportunity 
 Billions have gone into enterprise AI. Most of it isn't working — organisations still can't turn model capability into measurable business impact. That's not a training problem or a slide-deck problem. It's a hard, unsolved technical challenge: building the systems that translate what AI can do into how work actually gets done inside real organisations, at scale, with proof it's working. That's the problem Multiverse exists to solve, and it's the one this role exists to sell.
 Multiverse is seeking an exceptional Senior Product Marketing Manager to drive growth across both sides of our marketplace: attracting industry-leading enterprise partners and shaping a best-in-class platform experience for our learners.

 Create compelling, structured messaging and positioning statements that highlight product benefits and resonate with your audience. You will also organise internal communications to ensure company-wide alignment.

 Establish success metrics and analyse product performance, reporting to key stakeholders and using data to refine messaging and GTM strategies.

 Own competitive landscape analysis, becoming an expert on market trends to help shape the product roadmap.

 Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to align teams, deliver effective launches, and maintain trust with high-expectation stakeholders.

 Champion the voice of the customer in product and commercial decisions via research, feedback, and market analysis, collaborating with external research partners when useful.

 About you: 
 5+ years of relevant product marketing experience, including close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Marketing stakeholders.

 Track record of impact and excellence leading product marketing or strategy initiatives at hyper-growth companies.

 Proactive, effective communicator who adapts easily to changing priorities within a diverse, distributed team.

 Positive-sum mentality, balancing high-level strategic reflection with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and execute.

 Motivated by high-expectation stakeholders, with a proven ability to earn and retain trust through challenges.

 Confident user of AI to improve the speed and quality of your work, raising the bar for what is possible within the team.

You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.

 What You Will Do 

 Own the product strategy and roadmap for how free users become aware of, experience, and develop intent for Premium, driving consideration, conversion intent, and subscriber growth across segments and markets.

 Drive experiments that deepen our understanding of what makes users want Premium and measurably move free users closer to a purchase decision.

 Design rigorous A/B experiments to evaluate funnel changes against strong baselines, scaling approaches that demonstrably work across markets and segments.

 Make pragmatic trade-offs across user value, revenue impact, regional nuance, and operational complexity, knowing when a simple flow change is enough and when a deeper platform capability is needed.

 Partner with marketing, research, and regional teams to adapt value positioning and messaging for different markets, competitive landscapes, and user needs, including high-growth emerging markets where the path to Premium may look fundamentally different.

 Where You'll Be

 You have strong instincts for consumer value and what makes a product feel worth paying for, and understand how perception, positioning, and product experience work together to influence willingness to pay.

 You can break down the path from awareness to conversion, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and connect product decisions to downstream revenue outcomes such as ARPU, LTV, and net subscriber growth.

 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.

 Das wäre ein Plus

 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.

 
 Aufgabenbereich

 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.
